main_measure.name: pooled 5-bar excess forward return after extreme bars (forecast <= -10) minus coin-window drift
main_measure.threshold: confirm if negative with t <= -2 and negative in at least 2 coins; reject if >= 0 or negative in fewer than 2 coins with t > -1

supporting_check.name: Spearman rank correlation of |forecast| with next 5-bar return over bars with forecast < 0

decided_by: A negative pooled excess return with -2 < t <= -1 (or otherwise between rules), which is inconclusive.
reading: Drift is each window's mean 5-bar forward return over the same non-overlapping grid (positions 0,5,10,... from the window's first row), the 'at least 2 of the 3 coins' and 'at least 8 per coin' rules are applied to the coins present in the record (BTCUSD, ETHUSD; BNB is absent) with the threshold of 2 kept, and the supporting check uses all in-window bars with forecast < 0 and is reported but does not enter the decision.
